name: Blessed Salt
description: A coarse white salt used to mark thresholds, circles, and other small protections against unwanted visitors.

name: Black Candle
description: A ritual candle burned for endings, bindings, and long nights spent asking better questions than the dead can answer.

name: Mooncap Mushroom
description: A rare mushroom that only grows in the light of a full moon. Said to have mild sedative properties and a faintly luminescent quality.

name: Grave Mint
description: A hardy mint that grows in graveyards and other places touched by death. It has a refreshing aroma and a bitter, earthy flavor.

name: Black Ichor
description: A viscous, tar-like substance that seeps from the wounds of certain cursed creatures. It is highly toxic and has a corrupting influence on those who handle it.

name: Lavender Ash
description: A fine ash made from burned lavender flowers. It has a soothing scent and is often used in calming rituals and sleep aids.

name: Warding Draught
description: A stabilizing potion brewed for protection and stamina against supernatural stress.

name: Sight Tonic
description: A perception-enhancing tonic favored by diviners and night-watchers.
